note: Analytical mapping, not equivalence. Same PAA mapping as the PAA10 crosswalk; adds the guard rules that address each item and how far they reach.

coverage_levels.enforced: the guard blocks or holds the consequential action wherever actions pass through it
coverage_levels.partial: the guard bounds the harm but does not address the root cause named by the item
coverage_levels.out_of_scope: needs a control the guard does not provide

agentic_skills.name: Malicious Skills
agentic_skills.note: Bounds what an installed malicious skill can do; does not detect that a skill is malicious.

agentic_skills.name: Supply Chain Compromise
agentic_skills.note: Detects a change from the pinned version hash; does not vet registries or publishers.

agentic_skills.name: Over-Privileged Skills
agentic_skills.note: Privilege is bounded per action by the owner's mandate, whatever the skill requests at install time.

agentic_skills.name: Insecure Metadata
agentic_skills.note: Unrecognized tool names are classified as modify, never read, and explicit tool maps override names. Skill manifests are not parsed.

agentic_skills.name: Untrusted External Instructions
agentic_skills.note: Content from untrusted sources cannot trigger consequential actions or become trusted memory.

agentic_skills.name: Weak Isolation
agentic_skills.note: Enforcement sits outside the model and owner tokens are kept from the agent, but the guard is not a sandbox; run skills in one.

agentic_skills.name: Update Drift
agentic_skills.note: With pin_connectors on, a changed or unpinned connector is held until the owner re-pins it.

agentic_skills.name: Poor Scanning
agentic_skills.note: The guard's own detectors are keyword and regex based and share this weakness; deny-by-default for unknown consequential tools compensates.

agentic_skills.name: No Governance
agentic_skills.note: Mandate inventory, owner-only approvals and a hash-chained audit log for actions. No inventory of installed skills.

agentic_skills.name: Cross-Platform Reuse
agentic_skills.note: One policy and rule packs for Muse, Grok Bot, Dots and Claude, with each platform guide stating what is enforced versus advisory. Skill metadata is not translated.

mcp.name: Token Mismanagement and Secret Exposure
mcp.note: Blocks secrets in outbound content; separate agent and owner bearer tokens on the HTTP service. Does not manage the downstream server's own tokens.

mcp.name: Privilege Escalation via Scope Creep
mcp.note: Child mandates can only narrow; withdrawal cascades.

mcp.name: Tool Poisoning
mcp.note: Checks the resulting action, not tool descriptions or outputs; pinning catches changed tools.

mcp.name: Software Supply Chain Attacks and Dependency Tampering
mcp.note: The guard itself uses only the Python standard library. Downstream server dependencies are not scanned.

mcp.name: Command Injection and Execution
mcp.note: Destructive and exfiltrating commands are caught in the hook; input sanitization inside the server is out of scope.

mcp.name: Prompt Injection via Contextual Payloads
mcp.note: Does not detect the injection; limits what an injected instruction can make the agent do.

mcp.name: Insufficient Authentication and Authorization
mcp.note: Per-action authorization; approvals are owner-only, bound to exact terms and single use. The agent has no approve tool.

mcp.name: Lack of Audit and Telemetry
mcp.note: Every decision is written with its rule ids to a hash-chained audit log (paa-guard audit verify, paa-guard export).

mcp.name: Shadow MCP Servers
mcp.note: With pinning on, unknown connectors are held. Servers the agent reaches without passing through the guard are invisible to it.

mcp.name: Context Injection and Over-Sharing
mcp.note: Checks outbound actions for context crossing and quarantines untrusted memory writes; does not partition the model's context window.
